breakdown.title: The Horse of Ice
breakdown.logline: A young woman walks to the far end of a room and returns with a block of glittering ice replacing her head, which melts and carves itself into a beautifully molded horse's head.

colours.value: clear ice with glittering highlights, otherwise unremembered

texture.value: glittering, smooth, clear ice, with carved detail

breakdown.world_logic: A person's head can become a block of ice that melts and sculpts itself into a horse's head, and this is accepted as natural.

geography.value: a room with an autoclave near where they stood, and a far end

scenes.title: The Room
scenes.mood: calm, natural, like watching a carving rather than something alarming

moments.action: The dreamer and the young woman stand talking by the autoclave.
moments.visual_point: The young woman and the dreamer by the autoclave.

moments.action: The young woman excuses herself and walks off to the far end of the room.
The young woman stands with an irregular block of glittering ice set upon her shoulders in place of her head.
moments.looks_at: the autoclave side of the room
moments.visual_point: The ice block replacing her head.

leaves.now: an irregular block of glittering ice

moments.dream: a head replaced by a block of ice

moments.action: The ice starts to melt and trickle, little channels form, the angles round away, and the sculpturing goes on rapidly.
moments.feeling: like watching carving, not falling apart
moments.visual_point: The ice melting into channels and rounded shapes.

states.now: an irregular block of glittering ice

moments.action: It becomes a beautifully molded head of a horse, eyes, ears and nostrils faithfully carved out in the clearest ice, replacing her head.
moments.visual_point: The clear ice horse head, where her head was.
moments.dream: a horse's head of clear ice replaces her head

style_options.name: a luminous etching
style_options.dream: light that comes from nowhere and casts no clear shadow
style_options.line: Delicate lines with a faint rainbow sheen, like light through ice.
tokens: delicate etched lines in pale ink
hints of prismatic color at line edges
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is even and sourceless, giving gentle modelling. Edges are crisp but not harsh. Shadows are pale and diffuse.

style_options.name: a silverpoint drawing
style_options.dream: the stillness of a held breath
style_options.line: Cool gray lines, precise and calm, like frost on a window.
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is diffuse and soft, creating gentle gradients. Shadows are barely present. Edges remain sharp but not hard.

style_options.name: a chiaroscuro charcoal drawing
style_options.dream: edges a little too soft to hold
style_options.line: Deep shadows and melting light, like watching through a dark room.
style_options.lighting_rules: Strong light from one side, falling off into deep shadow. Shadows have soft edges. Highlights are bright but slightly diffused.

style_options.name: as it looked to you
style_options.line: Straightforward and real, like a memory you can almost touch.
style_options.lighting_rules: The light is plain and even, as in an ordinary room, with no dramatic shadows. Edges are soft only from slight defocus. The scene has a normal, unaltered colour balance.

m4.view: Seen from in front of them, a few metres off, at the height of their eyes: the camera looks toward the back of the room. A 50mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the young woman, the middle of the picture, facing the camera, seen from the waist up and filling the picture from near its top to its bottom edge. They keep these places in every picture of this scene. Also in the picture: the autoclave, the right third of the picture, filling the picture from a third of the way down to its bottom edge. Outside the picture, behind the camera: the entrance wall.
